integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo elementary graph covering, surface group and cellular-homology facts. A standard-library finite checker is supplied. This result has not been independently audited; publication priority is not certified.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to finite unit-edge square-grid surface quotients at side L at least five and their coordination-scale relation-length filtrations; it does not compare integral barcodes, other homology degrees, or smallest possible examples.
title: Identical coordination barcodes, different persistent fundamental groups on toroidal and Klein-bottle square grids
